families.name: Compose 的动画和转场
families.line: 读到源端 Compose Animatable.animateTo(tween(…, LinearEasing))、AnimatedVisibility(expandVertically / shrinkVertically)、NavHost 的 enterTransition / popExitTransition；产物里 setInterval / displaySync 驱动的进度、.transition(TransitionEffect…) 和 Navigation 的 customNavContentTransition
